blockingReviewFindings.finding: Recap says three spheres cross at a point, contradicting the earlier two-point explanation without explaining physical disambiguation.
The worked example does not clearly distinguish 300 metres of range error from actual position error; one blink is also a misleading description of a microsecond.
The fourth fixes your clock wording suggests separate satellite roles, rather than a joint solve of the four unknowns.
Broadcast orbital information and suitable satellite geometry are not adequately explained.
The four drawn range rings do not all pass through the highlighted receiver/fix. Free coordinate generation has not enforced the claimed geometric constraint.
Labels are markedly smaller than headings. Frame review and the model critic identify writing through box/circle/panel outlines.
QC reports two 2.1-second near-blank runs; narration timing includes a word ending 30 ms after its narration segment. Subjective cadence remains unverified.

qualitativeReferenceComparison: Golpo sampled frames integrate coordinated multi-panel scenes with consistent contour weight and larger, more legible captions. Inkcast v3 is still mostly independent per-beat diagrams with uneven stroke weights and small labels. This is an observed craft gap, not a numerical parity score.
